Items.Title: Live/Dev Server Split, Server Wipe, Rarity Visuals, Bug Fixes
Items.Body: Major improvements to servers, item visuals, tooltips, and bug fixes. Server was wiped to implement the new Live/Dev split.
Items.Details:
Live/Dev Server Split:
- The game now supports both a Live and a Dev server environment. Each environment has fully isolated save data and settings.
- The launcher also lets you choose which server to connect to before starting the game.

Rarity System & Visuals:
- Items now have a data-driven rarity system with five tiers (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary).
- Equipment and inventory items display their rarity with improved color highlights and clearer visuals.
- Rarity colors are now consistent and easier to read.

Equipment Tooltips:
- Hovering over equipped items now shows detailed tooltips, including all granted skills and effects.

Bug Fixes & Improvements:
- Fixed a bug that prevented players from leaving the Social UI under certain conditions.
- Fixed a bug where the ALQ stat (Alchemy) would not save correctly after logging out.
- General polish and color improvements for item rarity and tooltips.

As always, please report any issues or feedback!

Items.Title: Major Overhaul: UI, Combat, Merchants, Stats & More
Items.Body: This update delivers a sweeping overhaul across the UI, combat, stat system, merchant experience, and more. It includes a full server reset, new stat allocation and badge features, major combat and skill system changes, improved equipment tooltips, bug fixes, herb respawn timers, merchant tab organization, and deep technical improvements.
Items.Details:
Server Reset & Stat Overhaul:

All player data has been reset due to deep changes in the stat system. Accounts registered before this patch must be re-created.
Stat allocation system reworked: left panel now scrolls, +/− buttons always visible, and allocation section is never pushed off-screen.
Stat points badge: a gold badge appears on the 📋 C character button when you have unspent stat points, updating after every step and level-up.
StarterPointsGranted migration flag added; existing saves get 10 starter points on first load.

Combat & Skills:

Removed the hardcoded 'Power Strike' fallback skill. All skills now come exclusively from equipped gear. Skill button is disabled if no equipment grants skills.
Combat skills are now granted by equipped items (weapon, armor, accessory); your skill book rebuilds at the start of each combat encounter.
New skill types: Passive, Shield, LifeSteal, and more. Skills now have expanded properties for deeper customization.
Combat log improvements: reduced height, newest entries at the top, colored progress bars for HP, Stamina, XP, and enemy HP.
Damage formula: replaced linear subtraction with multiplicative scaling (damage = base * (1 + STR * 8%)), defense is now percentage-based, and damage range is now 0-to-maxHit (RuneScape-style).
Full solo/party combat consistency: server and client use the same STR%-based scaling and defense formulas.

Equipment Tooltips:

Hovering over equipment in the inventory now shows a ── Skills ── section listing each granted skill, including name, action type, damage type, power, stamina cost, cooldown, status effects, drain, heal, shield, and life steal.

Bug Fixes & Quality of Life:

Enemy spawn fix: enemy count no longer multiplies after combat; enemy tiles are now cleared before spawning a fresh batch.
Herb Respawn Timers: herbs can now regrow after a set number of seconds, and respawn is checked on every player movement step.
Merchant Tabs: shop inventory is now organized into four tabs—Equipment, General Goods, Herbs, and Materials—for easier browsing.
Crash Logging: app now catches all major unhandled exceptions and writes detailed crash logs to crash_log.txt.

Alchemy & Potions:

New Alchemy stat: each point gives 5% increased potion effectiveness.
Potion potency is now applied everywhere, both in and out of combat.

Items.Title: Game Crashes
Items.Body: If the game crashes during combat, please go into the game's installation folder and look for a file named crash_log.txt. This file contains detailed information about the crash and can help me identify and fix the issue.

Items.Title: Audio Update
Items.Body: Testing background audio in the Outskirts zone. Please report any issues with music playback or performance.

Items.Title: Servers Down for now
Items.Body: The servers are currently down as I work on fixing some critical bugs and implementing new features. I'm changing core systems related to combat, skills, and stats, which requires a full server reset. No ETA on when the servers will be back up.
